title: Apply for a vessel registration
summary: This page provides information on how to apply for a vessel registration to use a vessel on NSW waterways.
intro: To use a vessel on NSW waterways, it must be registered if it:
who_can_apply: Must be aged 16 or over to register a vessel.
what_you_need: Completed Application for Vessel Registration – PDF
HIN (Boat Code) certificate (if required, organize an inspection with a Boat Code Agent)
Vessel registration fee and concession card (if applicable)
Letter of Agreement for Recreational Vessel Registration from Transport for NSW (if the vessel was acquired under specific circumstances)

how_to_steps.text: Follow the prompts to make an appointment at a Service NSW Centre.
Lodge your application in person at your selected service centre.

faqs.q: Who can apply for a vessel registration?
faqs.a: You must be aged 16 or over to register a vessel.

faqs.q: What documents do I need to register my vessel?
faqs.a: You need your proof of identity, a completed Application for Vessel Registration – PDF, proof of acquisition, and the vessel registration fee and concession card (if applicable).

faqs.q: Do I need a HIN (Boat Code) certificate?
faqs.a: A HIN (Boat Code) certificate is required if you need one, and you must organize an inspection with a Boat Code Agent.
